latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Image to Markdown skill.
- Extracts text from images (PNG, JPG, WebP, BMP, TIFF) to Markdown using MinerU Open API.
- Supports both local image files and direct URLs.
- No API key, signup, or authentication required.
- Allows language hints for improved OCR accuracy.
- Designed for reading and converting text from screenshots, scanned pages, documents, and more.
